joint_audit.scope: Every physics substep in active episodes, including failures and terminal steps; commands before integration and measured state after integration
joint_audit.tracking_sampling: maximum pre/post-integration target error per physical substep, counted once
joint_audit.note: Zero sampled violations is an evaluation result, not a guarantee for unseen real-world states; no clipping is performed by this audit.

torque_audit.scope: Every physics substep in active episodes, including failures and terminal steps; not successful episodes only
torque_audit.note: Zero sampled violations is an evaluation result, not a guarantee for unseen real-world states.

successful_episode_gait.sampling: pre-step; active environments with episode_length > 1; differences require consecutive valid frames
successful_episode_gait.planar_velocity_mae_definition: mean absolute error across vx and vy components in body frame
successful_episode_gait.forward_velocity_definition: course_forward_velocity uses world +X (stair ascent direction); body_forward_velocity and forward_velocity_mae use body vx; means weight valid control samples
successful_episode_gait.stairs_traversal_definition: first complete forward crossing from stair start to end in each episode; boundaries linearly interpolated between consecutive valid pre-step samples; elapsed time includes retreats; one value per completed crossing; spawned-inside, interrupted and incomplete crossings excluded; geometric completion is not episode success
successful_episode_gait.power_definition: mean sum(abs(applied_torque * joint_velocity)), not electrical power
successful_episode_gait.joint_acceleration_definition: finite difference at control step interval
successful_episode_gait.hip_abduction_definition: URDF hip angle multiplied by left +1 / right -1; positive is outward; over-limit fraction uses signed angle > maximum, not absolute angle
successful_episode_gait.hip_outward_component_definition: mean(max(signed hip angle, 0)); unlike signed mean this cannot be reduced by inward angles; adduction fraction separately counts signed angles below zero
successful_episode_gait.feet_lateral_definition: foot position relative to root, rotated into full body frame (including roll/pitch), with left +y / right -y positive outward; all gait phases; pair width sums left and right signed lateral positions
successful_episode_gait.feet_cross_body_center_definition: signed foot lateral coordinate below zero; distinct from merely being inside the configured positive minimum width

stairs_lateral_sampling.definition: stairs_ metrics include only valid pre-step frames whose base center is within the stair flight horizontal projection; approach and upper platform excluded; this does not classify individual foot contacts
